metadata.title: When 2 kills feel like a full team wipe but you’re still just a potato in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, I got 2 kills and suddenly I’m the whole squad?
Valorant logic really out here confusing us.
Watch me pretend my aim showed up for once.
Click if your luck once made you look like a god!

Tap if you’ve ever acted like a legend with half the kills!

#valorant #funnyclips #luckygamer #gaming #shorts
